title: by the rain
direction: Let the title idea stay implicit. Use fast, narrow clusters and short lulls, with one or two heavier low-frequency accents. Avoid a literal wall of rain and avoid beat-for-drop mapping.

sections.name: needles: opening
sections.note: Narrow fast clusters cross the surface, separated by short lulls. Measured note patterns carry the main surface; incidental weather is held behind them.
